collection.description: At a village festival, a father carries his baby through the crowd.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At a village festival, (name1), a father, carries his baby through the crowd. The child seems fascinated by the music, the woven banners, and a particularly shiny spoon.

choices.label: Let the Baby Examine a Safe Toy

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The baby falls asleep before the music grows lively.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The baby hides against his shoulder and refuses to perform.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They watch the lanterns together from the edge of the crowd.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: He misses part of the celebration but enjoys the calm.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

d1.text: The child becomes absorbed in its bright ribbons.

d2.text: The toy is immediately discarded in favor of the spoon.
